description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Pyrogenius onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+2 Chandra, Pyrogenius dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Pyrogenius to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
